recognize_zh: 這是一張 3D 示意圖：紅色、雙凹圓盤狀（biconcave disc）、中央凹陷而邊緣較厚的無核細胞，即正常紅血球的立體外形，對應抹片上中央淡染區（central pallor）的由來。
features: Three-dimensional rendered illustration, not a photomicrograph
Biconcave disc shape with a thick rounded rim and thin central depression
Central depression corresponds to central pallor (about one-third of diameter) on smears
describe_en: This is a schematic three-dimensional illustration of a normal erythrocyte rather than a microscopic image. It depicts an anucleate biconcave disc with a thickened peripheral rim and a thin central depression. On a Wright-stained peripheral smear this geometry produces a round cell of roughly 7-8 micrometers with central pallor occupying about one-third of the diameter. The depiction is consistent with normal red cell morphology.
